construct_model_graph: construct a BMGraphBuilder model graph with nested if-then-else nodes and normal distributions
test_nested_if_cons_fix: test the nested if consequence fixer that simplifies IF(COND, IF(COND, CONS2, ALT2), ALT1) to IF(COND, CONS2, ALT1)
test_nested_if_alt_fix: test the nested if alternative fixer that simplifies IF(COND, CONS1, IF(COND, CONS2, ALT2)) to IF(COND, CONS1, ALT2)
to_dot_before_transform: generate a DOT graph representation of the BMGraphBuilder model before applying the nested if transform
to_dot_after_transform: generate a DOT graph representation of the BMGraphBuilder model after applying the nested if transform
